In nineteen eighty-three, a wild dolphin swam into a tiny Irish harbor. Alone.
Every day, he swam beside the fishing boats.
Boat tours promised your money back if he didn't show up.
When lockdown emptied the harbor, one boatman went out anyway, just to keep him company.
Everyone needs someone who shows up.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny shows up for you, every day.
